reasons.publication: Use the canonical ST publication workflow.
reasons.evaluation_error: Publication guard could not evaluate tool input; execution refused.
reasons.too_deep: This command nests eval, bash -c, $(...), heredocs or ssh more than {limit} levels deep, too deep for the guard to check; execution refused. Write it with less nesting.
reasons.too_large: This command is over {limit} bytes, too large for the guard to check; execution refused. Put long input in a file and pass the file.
reasons.too_slow: The guard could not finish checking this command within {limit} ms; execution refused. Split it into smaller commands.

messages.git_force_push_main: BLOCKED:git push --force main:Force push to main/master destroys shared history; publish with 'st vcs publish'.
messages.git_reset_hard: BLOCKED:git reset --hard:Discards every agent's uncommitted work in this shared checkout; restore only your files with 'git restore -- <path>' or checkpoint with 'st commit --paths <path>'.
messages.git_clean: BLOCKED:git clean:Permanently deletes untracked files other agents may own; remove your own files by explicit path (rm <path>), preview with 'git clean -n'.
messages.git_checkout_all: BLOCKED:git checkout .:Discards every agent's uncommitted changes in this shared checkout; name your own files: 'git checkout -- <path>'.
messages.git_restore_all: BLOCKED:git restore .:Discards every agent's uncommitted changes in this shared checkout; name your own files: 'git restore -- <path>'.
messages.git_stash_drop: BLOCKED:git stash drop/clear:Permanently deletes stashed work; leave stashes in place and inspect them with 'git stash list' / 'git stash show'.
messages.git_stash: BLOCKED:git stash:Sweeps other agents' uncommitted changes out of this shared checkout; checkpoint your own files with 'st commit --paths <path>' instead.
messages.rm_protected_root: BLOCKED:rm -r {target}:Recursive delete of a protected root (home, /srv, workspace or project root, mounted storage) is irreversible; delete the specific subpaths you own instead.
messages.disk_advice: destroys every byte on a real disk and agents never run it; practice on an image file or loop device under /srv/scratch, or ask the owner to run it.
messages.wipefs: BLOCKED:wipefs:Erasing filesystem signatures {disk_advice} List with plain 'wipefs <dev>'.
messages.dd_device: BLOCKED:dd of=/dev:Writing raw data to a device {disk_advice} Write to a regular file instead.
messages.parted: BLOCKED:parted:Changing a partition table {disk_advice} Inspect with 'parted -l' or 'parted <dev> print'.
messages.partitioner: BLOCKED:{name}:Repartitioning a disk {disk_advice} Inspect with 'lsblk' or 'fdisk -l'.
messages.cryptsetup: BLOCKED:cryptsetup:Formatting or erasing a LUKS header makes the data unrecoverable; it {disk_advice}
messages.btrfs_subvolume_delete: BLOCKED:btrfs subvolume delete:Deleting btrbk/snapper snapshots or subvolumes on protected storage destroys backup history; snapshot retention belongs to btrbk/snapper. Inspect with 'btrfs subvolume list'.
messages.restic: BLOCKED:restic {action}:Permanently deletes backup snapshots, data, or keys; retention runs only from the scheduled SummitFlow backup jobs. Inspect with 'restic snapshots' or preview with '--dry-run'.
messages.rclone_mirror: BLOCKED:rclone {action}:Mirroring onto a remote deletes destination files that the source lacks (offsite backups such as summitflow-drive live there); offsite uploads run only from the scheduled backup jobs. Preview with --dry-run, or use 'rclone copy', which never deletes.
messages.rclone_delete: BLOCKED:rclone {action}:Deletes files on a remote (offsite backups such as summitflow-drive live there); offsite expiry runs only from the scheduled backup jobs. Inspect with 'rclone ls'/'rclone lsd' or add --dry-run.
messages.btrbk: BLOCKED:btrbk {action}:Deletes btrbk snapshots and backups outside the scheduled retention run; preview with 'btrbk -n' / '--dry-run' or inspect with 'btrbk list'.
messages.dmsetup: BLOCKED:dmsetup {action}:Tearing down a device-mapper device (LUKS, LVM) under a mounted system can corrupt or strand its data; only loop-backed scratch mappings may be removed. Inspect with 'dmsetup ls'.
messages.find_delete: BLOCKED:find {target} -delete:Bulk delete across a protected root (home, /srv, workspace or project root, mounted storage) is irreversible; narrow it with -name/-path to files you own, or delete specific subpaths.
messages.proxmox_advice: destroys Proxmox/LVM/ZFS storage or guests with no undo; VM and storage lifecycle is owner-run. Inspect with 'qm list', 'pct list', 'lvs', 'zfs list', or 'pvesm status'.
